dict.cc: English-German
and Multilingual Dictionary

The goal of dict.cc is to make it possible to share your vocabulary knowledge with the world. This is the main difference from other translation services - every user is encouraged to contribute to the English-German dictionary by adding and/or verifying translation suggestions. The resulting vocabulary database can be downloaded and used for free.

Besides browsing the dictionary or searching for German-English translations you can also ask and answer questions related to the German or English language using the translation forum. To improve your language skills try the vocabulary trainer.

Disclaimer: The correctness of the translations cannot be guaranteed (nobody is perfect), but all input will be checked carefully. If you spot an error, please report it using the info button [i] located next to each translation within the search results.
News & History (RSS)
2026-11-06: 24 years of dict.cc
This year was difficult. I had to deal with compliance issues, system overloads, rising server costs and a steep decline in earnings. Many of those problems were caused by AI technology. A lot of people use AI software for full-text translation nowadays, so dictionaries are not needed as much as in previous years. But as opposed to their users, AI tools constantly check dictionaries to train their vocabularies. They harvest the data in bulk that we enter, verify, and correct one by one. Earlier this year, dict.cc struggled with server overloads and crashes for weeks, as AI crawlers generated (and still generate) millions of page requests each day. But thanks to several measures, like increasing server capacities, adding blocklists and various software adjustments, dict.cc's servers are running smoothly again by now. Also regarding the economic situation that looked pretty bad until recently, there are developments pointing in the right direction again.

Here are the figures on content development at dict.cc as of today:
1,319,570 German-English translations, 2,695,692 translations in other language pairs
1,568,739 audio recordings, 1,759,457 inflection entries and 428,838 illustrating images
321,358 registered users, 39,198 of them contributors (thank you!)
2026-11-04: Ukrainian-English has reached 30,000 translations! Congratulations to the contributors!
2026-07-01: Slovak-German has reached 100,000 translation entries today!
This makes Slovak the second language to reach the 100k milestone in both of dict.cc's language combinations! Congratulations and thanks to the contributors!
2025-11-14: Russian-English has reached 30,000 translations! Congratulations to the contributors!
